methodologyNotes: Roster covers 11 real, currently- or recently-cataloged mirrorless/cinema camera cages from SmallRig, Tilta, 8Sinn, and Neewer: full cages, one half cage, one advanced multi-handle cage kit, and one bundled 'Advanced Kit' built around a cage plus handles/baseplate. During this fact-check pass B&H Photo and Adorama returned HTTP 403 to automated retrieval, so headline specs and prices were re-verified against the manufacturer sites (smallrig.com, tilta.com, neewer.com, 8sinn.com), SmallRig's authorized-reseller catalog mirror (smallrigreseller.com — confirmed live, with full spec tables and prices), and dated trade press (CineD, Newsshooter). weight_g is the grams figure for the cage unit as listed by the manufacturer/reseller spec table (nulled, not estimated, when a listing bundles handles/rods into one combined weight). nato_rail, arca_swiss_baseplate, and quick_release_compatible are booleans for features built into the base cage (not optional add-on purchases); nulled where a checked spec page did not corroborate the feature. priceUsd is the manufacturer/authorized-reseller regular list price in USD. accessedAt 2026-08-16.

products.name: Tilta Camera Cage for BMPCC 4K/6K Advanced Kit — Black

The kit uses a 15mm LWS rod baseplate, not an Arca-Swiss dovetail, so arca_swiss_baseplate and quick_release_compatible are false; cold-shoe count, NATO rail, and cage-only weight are not broken out from the combined kit, so left null.
